shopify.title: Mira pillow bag
shopify.descriptionHtml:
Mira has a gently rounded pillow silhouette with a zip opening and two straps. Its medium-soft structure and understated profile bring a relaxed shape to an everyday edit.

  • Pillow silhouette
  • Zip opening
  • Internal card pocket and zippered compartment
